look.summary_zh: 黑白 · 提亮中灰 · 中段拉开
look.description_zh: 50% 灰输出 Y′ 144.0/255（变化 +16.5 码值）；25%–75% 灰跨度比 1.239。中灰红减蓝 +0.0 码值。浅/中/深肤色色块分别输出 #E6E6E6、#B0B0B0、#4F4F4F；红/绿/蓝测试块分别输出 #4B4B4B、#C2C2C2、#636363。
look.description_en: 50% gray Y′ 144.0/255 (+16.5 code values); 25–75% gray span ratio 1.239; mid-gray red minus blue +0.0 code values. Light/medium/deep skin swatches: #E6E6E6, #B0B0B0, #4F4F4F. Red/green/blue swatches: #4B4B4B, #C2C2C2, #636363.
look.suggested_use_zh: 黑白纪实、建筑与轮廓试片
look.suggested_use_en: Compare on your own SDR product, portrait and landscape footage before selecting.
look.cautions_zh: 强度低于 1 会混回原始彩色。仅像素颜色映射，不生成颗粒、光晕、暗角、空间雾或美颜；未做自然画质验收。
look.cautions_en: Pixel color mapping only; no grain, glow, vignette, spatial haze or beauty effects. Natural footage quality is unaccepted. Check skin/product colors and clipped output.
